externalBIOSReference.meaning: AX1000 invokes SetSinglePaletteRegister(BL,BH). Reference used to interpret BIOS calls only; no emulator code or dependency copied.

interpretation: Glyph and span write low color bits directly, so palette applies to all paths.
Retaining bitmap1 is necessary for XOR14 to yield15white instead of14yellow.
limits: Static driver analysis, not execution of original BIOS/hardware.
Full masks/occlusion and display calibration remain unfinished.
